lines: I'm a brand new biology textbook.
Day one, she highlighted every single line.
Then she never opened me again.
Four months in a backpack. Under a banana.
The banana did not make it.
The night before the final. Two A M.
The night before the final. 2 AM.
She reread chapter four. Five times.
Then her roommate, Priya, showed her Unspool.
Nine short reels. A quiz in every one.
She learned it on the bus.
Try it free, at unspool dot c c.
